auth.signOut.text: Your messages stay on the server. To come back you will need your username and password.
auth.welcome.tagline: Warm conversations with the people you love — wherever you are
auth.welcome.pendingLink: Sign in or create an account and the link will open.
auth.welcome.feature.chats: Messages, photos and voice notes — in private chats and groups
auth.welcome.feature.calls: Voice and video calls with family and friends
auth.welcome.feature.private: Your own server: your conversations stay with you
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.subtitle: Enter your username and password
auth.login.forgot: Forgot your password? It can't be reset by SMS — ask the person who set up the server for help.
auth.login.invalid: Wrong username or password. Check the keyboard layout and try again.
auth.login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
auth.login.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection or the server address below.
auth.register.title: New account
auth.register.subtitle: It takes a minute. No phone number or e-mail needed.
auth.register.privacy: People you talk to see your name and photo. You can add a phone number later if you want.
auth.register.closedText: This server is not accepting new accounts right now. Ask the server owner to open registration, or sign in to an existing account.
auth.field.passwordHint: At least {0} characters. Keep it somewhere safe.
auth.field.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {0} characters
auth.field.name: Your name
auth.field.nameHint: This is how others will see you
auth.field.usernameHint: Others can find you by it. Latin letters, digits and “_”.
auth.field.inviteHint: The server owner gives out the code
auth.field.inviteNeeded: This server needs an invite code to create an account — please enter it
auth.username.taken: This username is taken — try another one
auth.username.invalid: Start with a Latin letter; letters, digits and “_”, at least {0} characters
auth.username.reserved: This username is reserved — try another one
auth.server.title: Server
auth.server.hint: The person who set up the server will give you its address. Usually nothing needs to change.
auth.server.notFoundSave: The server at this address is not answering. Check the address, or press “Save” again to use it anyway.
auth.server.invalid: Enter an address such as chat.example.com
